hook: Langfuse went open-core. Arize Phoenix published the 2026 GenAI semconv mappings. Helicone and Braintrust both doubled down on per-user cost attribution. Traceloop's OpenLLMetry became the de-facto SDK instrumentation. The production shape is ClickHouse for traces, Postgres for metadata, Next.js for UI, and a small army of eval jobs (DeepEval, RAGAS, LLM-judge) running over sampled traces. Build one self-hosted, ingest from at least four SDK families, and demonstrate catching an injected regression in under five minutes.
